tiny_llama_fp8_consistent.note: fp8_consistent capture is all-f32 in the graph (the fp32 vectorized matmul path).
tiny_llama_fp8_consistent.reason: fused_vfmacc_tiled raises PipelineError: batch_matmul attention dim N=8 tiled NR=16 -> masked vector<1x4x16>->tensor<1x4x8> transfer_write that LLVM-23 lowering rejects (vector.mask op expects only one operation to mask).

small_llama_fp8_consistent.reason: same vector.mask N=8 batch_matmul failure as tiny_llama.
small_llama_fp8_consistent.k1_run: ran (small, 577KB weights) but produced ALL-NaN on BOTH the board and spike for the frozen baseline -> this fp8->f32 capture is numerically broken on the RVV path; not a usable correctness target.
